verdict.rationale: Clerky is explicitly a Delaware incorporation platform covering formation filing, customizable bylaws/legal paperwork, stock plans, and collaborative workflows for founders/co-founders and attorneys, with community reviews confirming end-to-end use for incorporation. missing for 10: no explicit first-party confirmation of 'initial board approvals' as a named document/step, and no independent hands-on report walking through the full filing-to-approval sequence.
